nodes.objective: Implement a small Rust parse_port function that accepts decimal ports 1 through 65535 and rejects empty, signed, out-of-range and non-numeric input. Add regression tests. Full behavior is specified here; no external research is needed.
acceptance: Valid ports accepted; invalid inputs rejected; regression tests pass

nodes.objective: Create a self-contained responsive HTML mockup for a port validator, with inline CSS, one labeled input, a validate button and clear success/error states. Use no dependencies or network resources. Only create mockup.html; do not touch parser.rs.
acceptance: Single accessible responsive HTML file; no external assets

nodes.objective: Independently review parser.rs after its implementation completes. Check port boundaries and malformed input against the exact implementation contract and regression tests. Write a review report; do not change implementation files.
acceptance: Review cites actual source and test evidence; unrun checks labeled
